title: Grupo Sanirent
description: sanirent.com.mx Grupo Sanirent is a 100 percent Mexican company founded in 1983 in Mexico City, the national leader in portable toilet rental, mobile offices, septic services and waste management. With 178 employees and operations in all 32 Mexican states, it serves everything from private events and luxury weddings to massive construction sites and industrial operations. Its business lines include standard and VIP portable toilets, camper-style luxury stations, mobile office rentals, industrial drain cleaning with specialized vactor and guzzler trucks, and full waste collection including hazardous and bio-infectious materials. The company holds ISO 9001 certification and has won 53 government contracts with major institutions like IMSS, CFE, CAPUFE and the National Culture Secretariat. Its premium Eventos Especiales division provides luxury sanitary facilities for high-end events across the country. Key strengths are 43 years of experience, full national coverage, diversified service.
